vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of words whose meaning is different from the meanings of each word
vocabulary.note_ar: مثل It's raining cats and dogs = تمطر بغزارة
vocabulary.note_en: e.g. It's raining cats and dogs = it's raining a lot
vocabulary.example: "Keep an eye on" is a common idiom.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give or communicate a meaning
vocabulary.example: Idioms convey a lot of meaning in a few words.
My legs are sore after the gym.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something very ugly to look at
vocabulary.example: That old building is an eyesore.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone believe something that is not true
vocabulary.example: I would never try to deceive you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take the skin off fruit or vegetables
vocabulary.example: Peel the banana before you eat it.
The little boy was bashful with visitors.
Leaders and athletes are always in the public eye.

fine_lines.title: keep an eye on vs keep an eye out for vs keep your eyes peeled
fine_lines.explanation_ar: keep an eye on: راقب شيئًا موجودًا بعناية. keep an eye out for: انتبه لشيء أو شخص سيصل. keep your eyes peeled: راقب بتركيز شديد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Keep an eye on: watch something that is there. Keep an eye out for: watch for something that will arrive. Keep your eyes peeled: watch very carefully.

examples.sentence: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
Keep an eye out for the waiter.
Keep your eyes peeled for the exit sign.

fine_lines.title: catch someone's eye vs have an eye for
fine_lines.explanation_ar: catch someone's eye: يلفت انتباهه. have an eye for: لديه ذوق ويعرف الجيد من الرديء.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Catch someone's eye: get their attention. Have an eye for: be good at seeing quality.

examples.sentence: A red dress in the window caught my eye.
She has a good eye for colours.

expressions.example: The bright colour of the shirt caught my eye, so I bought it.
You've always had a good eye for clothing.

expressions.meaning_en: something so ugly it hurts to look at it
expressions.example: The blue shirt I bought was an eyesore.
Keep an eye on the soup so it doesn't burn.

expressions.phrase: pull the wool over someone's eyes
expressions.example: I wouldn't try to pull the wool over your eyes.

expressions.meaning_en: more to it than is obvious
expressions.example: There is more to this old house than meets the eye.
Keep your eyes peeled for our bus.

expressions.meaning_en: watch for someone or something arriving
expressions.example: Keep an eye out for a package for me.

expressions.meaning_en: well known and watched by the public
expressions.example: Famous athletes live in the public eye.
Take an umbrella; it's raining cats and dogs.

questions.question: "The bright colour of the shirt ___ my eye, so I bought it."
"You've always had a good ___ for clothing." (good taste)
questions.explanation_ar: have an eye for = لديه ذوق.
questions.explanation_en: Have an eye for = good taste.

questions.question: "The shirt was so ugly. It was an ___."
"Can you ___ my bag while I buy a ticket?" (watch it)
"I wouldn't try to deceive you." =
choices: I wouldn't pull the wool over your eyes.
I wouldn't keep an eye on you.
I wouldn't be in the public eye.
questions.explanation_ar: pull the wool over someone's eyes = يخدعه.
questions.explanation_en: Pull the wool over someone's eyes = deceive.

questions.question: "There is a lot more to her than is obvious." =
choices: There is more to her than meets the eye.
questions.explanation_ar: more than meets the eye = أكثر مما يبدو.
questions.explanation_en: More than meets the eye = more than is obvious.

questions.question: Presidents and famous athletes are always ___.
questions.explanation_ar: in the public eye = تحت أنظار الناس.
questions.explanation_en: In the public eye = watched by the public.

questions.question: "Keep an eye ___ the waiter; I want to order." (watch for him to come)
questions.explanation_ar: keep an eye out for = يترقّب.
questions.explanation_en: Keep an eye out for = watch for arrival.
